payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones, with the mug and headphones identifiable as the objects in the source image.
outcome.reference: The headphones and mug in the source image; compare their left-to-right positions in the edited image.

check.question: Are the mug and headphones identifiable in the edited image, and can their relative left-to-right positions be assessed?
check.complete_when: Both the mug and headphones are identifiable and their relative positions are clear.
check.partial_when: One or both objects are visible, but their identities or relative positions cannot be determined confidently.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the mug or headphones are absent or that the image provides no usable evidence about them.
check.unknown_when: The edited image is unavailable or otherwise insufficient to assess the objects and their positions.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image clearly shows an identifiable mug and headphones, and their left-to-right positions are assessable."}
